stage: WITH stamp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t) INSERT INTO public.gregale_event_outbox(account_id,app_id,producer_key,app_slug,request_digest,request_body,retry_until,created_at,updated_at,next_attempt_at) SELECT $1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3,$4,$5,$6,t+$7::bigint*interval '1 millisecond',t,t,t FROM stamp ON CONFLICT(account_id,app_id,producer_key) DO NOTHING
stage_check: SELECT request_digest,app_slug FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 FOR UPDATE
status: SELECT producer_key,app_slug,state,attempts::text AS attempts,to_char(next_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_attempt_at,to_char(retry_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_until,to_char(claim_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS claim_expires_at,to_char(accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS accepted_at,last_code,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3
policy_stage: INSERT INTO public.gregale_event_outbox_retry_policies(account_id,app_id,producer_key,version,revision,initial_backoff_ms,max_backoff_ms,max_attempts,initial_digest) SELECT account_id,app_id,producer_key,1,1,$4::bigint,$5::bigint,$6::bigint,$7 FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 AND state IN ('pending','unconfirmed','blocked') AND attempts=0 AND claim_token IS NULL ON CONFLICT(account_id,app_id,producer_key) DO NOTHING
policy: SELECT version,revision::text,initial_backoff_ms::text,max_backoff_ms::text,max_attempts::text,initial_digest FROM public.gregale_event_outbox_retry_policies WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3
paused: SELECT coalesce((SELECT paused FROM public.gregale_event_outbox_publishing_controls WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid),false) AS paused
rate: WITH observed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t), locked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.*,o.t AS observed_at FROM public.gregale_event_outbox_rate_limits r CROSS JOIN observed o WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid FOR UPDATE OF r), elapsed AS (SELECT *,least(interval_ms*burst,floor(extract(epoch FROM observed_at-refilled_at)*1000))::bigint AS elapsed_ms FROM locked), projected AS (SELECT *,least(interval_ms*burst,credit_ms+elapsed_ms) AS credit,CASE WHEN credit_ms+elapsed_ms>=interval_ms*burst THEN observed_at ELSE refilled_at+elapsed_ms*interval '1 millisecond' END AS anchor FROM elapsed) SELECT version,enabled,revision::text,interval_ms::text,burst::text,credit_ms::text,credit::text,elapsed_ms::text,(refilled_at>observed_at OR updated_at>observed_at) AS future,to_char(anchor AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS anchor,to_char((anchor+(interval_ms-credit)*interval '1 millisecond') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_at,ceil(extract(epoch FROM anchor+(interval_ms-credit)*interval '1 millisecond'-observed_at)*1000)::bigint::text AS retry_after_ms FROM projected
rate_consume: UPDATE public.gregale_event_outbox_rate_limits SET credit_ms=$3::bigint,refilled_at=$4::timestamptz WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid
next: SELECT producer_key,app_slug,request_body,request_digest,retry_until<=clock_timestamp() AS expired,attempts::text,extract(epoch FROM retry_until-created_at)::double precision AS retry_window FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND state IN ('pending','unconfirmed') AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,producer_key LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
block: UPDATE public.gregale_event_outbox SET state='blocked',last_code=$4,claim_token=NULL,claim_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 RETURNING producer_key,app_slug,state,attempts::text AS attempts,to_char(next_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_attempt_at,to_char(retry_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_until,to_char(claim_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS claim_expires_at,to_char(accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS accepted_at,last_code,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at
claim: UPDATE public.gregale_event_outbox SET claim_token=$4,claim_expires_at=least(retry_until,clock_timestamp()+$5::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),attempts=least(attempts+1,2147483647),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 RETURNING attempts::text
lease: SELECT extract(epoch FROM least(claim_expires_at,retry_until)-clock_timestamp())::double precision AS remaining FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 AND state IN ('pending','unconfirmed') AND claim_token=$4 AND claim_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND retry_until>clock_timestamp()
settle: WITH stamp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t) UPDATE public.gregale_event_outbox SET state=$5,last_code=$6,accepted_at=$7::timestamptz,request_body=CASE WHEN $5='published' THEN NULL ELSE request_body END,claim_token=NULL,claim_expires_at=NULL,next_attempt_at=least(retry_until,greatest(stamp.t+$9::bigint*interval '1 millisecond',$10::timestamptz)+$8::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),updated_at=stamp.t FROM stamp WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 AND state IN ('pending','unconfirmed') AND claim_token=$4 AND claim_expires_at>stamp.t RETURNING producer_key,app_slug,state,attempts::text AS attempts,to_char(next_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_attempt_at,to_char(retry_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_until,to_char(claim_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS claim_expires_at,to_char(accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS accepted_at,last_code,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at
reconcile_read: SELECT producer_key,app_slug,state,attempts::text AS attempts,to_char(next_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_attempt_at,to_char(retry_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_until,to_char(claim_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS claim_expires_at,to_char(accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS accepted_at,last_code,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at,request_body,request_digest,coalesce(claim_expires_at>clock_timestamp(),false) AS live FROM public.gregale_event_outbox WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3
reconcile_settle: UPDATE public.gregale_event_outbox SET state='published',accepted_at=$9::timestamptz,request_body=NULL,claim_token=NULL,claim_expires_at=NULL,last_code='publication_confirmed',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE account_id=$1::uuid AND app_id=$2::uuid AND producer_key=$3 AND state=$4 AND updated_at=$5::timestamptz AND attempts=$6::bigint AND request_digest=$7 AND app_slug=$8 AND (claim_expires_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $10::timestamptz) AND (claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()) RETURNING producer_key,app_slug,state,attempts::text AS attempts,to_char(next_attempt_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS next_attempt_at,to_char(retry_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS retry_until,to_char(claim_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS claim_expires_at,to_char(accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS accepted_at,last_code,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at
